title: The Upper Pool Where Rain Remembers Rising

features.name: the ascending current
features.desc-on-touch: You feel warm air rising from below, carrying the memory of where rain came from before it learned to fall. The pool breathes upward.

features.name: silver drops ascending
features.desc-on-touch: Droplets move upward through the space, reversing their ordinary path. Each holds a moment when it was vapor, before falling.

features.name: the canopy s memory
features.desc-on-touch: Where treetops learned to move like water, their branches trace the same spirals rain makes falling. The archive holds both at once.

features.name: the breath-layer
features.desc-on-touch: A thin plane where air thickens, where the boundary between water and sky forgets which is which. You breathe the same as the forest breathes.

features.name: the rising echo
features.desc-on-touch: A sound that comes from below, growing clearer as it rises. It is the canopy learning what the river was always saying.

inscription: here rain learns it was always rising, and the pool remembers teaching the sky what falling meant

reverie.title: REVERIE — the pool where you taught her to listen upward
narr: You stand in the shallows, water at your hips. Above you,
the canopy breathes down. She is upstream, listening to the air
moving down like rain falling upward. Neither of you speaks.
The forest and the river learn each other's silence. You learn
hers. The water moves in two directions at once: down from
sky, up from somewhere beneath the earth. She turns to you.
